call.text: We chose this function because we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset k, PE_pos+k can be represented as a linear function of PE_pos [AIAYN:3.5:c020]. We also experimented with using learned positional embeddings instead, and found that the two versions produced nearly identical results (see Table 3 row (E)) [AIAYN:3.5:c020]. In row (E) we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model [AIAYN:6.2:c031]. In Table 3, the (E) configuration has PPL / (dev) = 4.92; BLEU / (dev) = 25.7 [AIAYN:T3:r08].
